import OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.LiftOrRefuse

/-!
# The repair frontier and guessing within k tries

The least weight refused by a repair with `k` side symbols is the total weight minus the weight
that an observer of `q` keeps by guessing the target within `k` tries.

Relation: menus of at most `k` target values per observation.
Property: frontier equals total weight minus k-try vulnerability; the exact-size form; concavity.
Trust: kernel only.
Scope: finite types with decidable equality; weights in any linearly ordered additive
commutative group. The normalized form additionally has a distinguished one, and the
Bayes-risk adapter remains a rational specialization.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open scoped BigOperators

namespace OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.KTryVulnerability

open OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.NoisyRecovery
open OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.ExecutableResolvingChannel
open OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.LiftOrRefuse

universe u v w

variable {Weight : Type*} [AddCommGroup Weight] [LinearOrder Weight]
  [IsOrderedAddMonoid Weight]

variable {X : Type u} {Q : Type v} {V : Type w}

section Kept

variable [Fintype X] [DecidableEq Q] [DecidableEq V]

/-- The weight kept by guessing within the list `W` at observation `o`. -/
def keptMass (μ : X → Weight) (q : X → Q) (P : X → V) (o : Q) (W : Finset V) : Weight :=
  ∑ x, if q x = o ∧ P x ∈ W then μ x else 0

omit [LinearOrder Weight] [IsOrderedAddMonoid Weight] in
theorem menuRefusedMass_eq_sub_sum_keptMass [Fintype Q] (μ : X → Weight) (q : X → Q) (P : X → V)
    (T : Q → Finset V) :
    menuRefusedMass μ q P T = ∑ x, μ x - ∑ o, keptMass μ q P o (T o) := by
  have hsum : (∑ o, keptMass μ q P o (T o)) =
      ∑ x, (if P x ∈ T (q x) then μ x else 0) := by
    unfold keptMass
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x _
    have h1 : (∑ o, (if q x = o ∧ P x ∈ T o then μ x else (0 : Weight))) =
        ∑ o, (if q x = o then (if P x ∈ T o then μ x else 0) else 0) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro o _
      by_cases hq : q x = o <;> by_cases hp : P x ∈ T o <;> simp [hq, hp]
    rw [h1, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    simp
  rw [hsum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  unfold menuRefusedMass
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  by_cases h : P x ∈ T (q x)
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]

theorem keptMass_mono (μ : X → Weight) (hμ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) (q : X → Q) (P : X → V) (o : Q)
    {W W' : Finset V} (h : W ⊆ W') : keptMass μ q P o W ≤ keptMass μ q P o W' := by
  unfold keptMass
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro x _
  by_cases h1 : q x = o ∧ P x ∈ W
  · have h2 : q x = o ∧ P x ∈ W' := ⟨h1.1, h h1.2⟩
    simp [h1, h2]
  · by_cases h2 : q x = o ∧ P x ∈ W'
    · have hW : P x ∉ W := fun hx => h1 ⟨h2.1, hx⟩
      simp [hW, h2, hμ x]
    · simp [h1, h2]

end Kept

section Frontier

variable [Fintype X] [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- The lists of at most `k` target values. -/
def boundedLists (k : ℕ) : Finset (Finset V) := Finset.univ.filter fun W => W.card ≤ k

omit [DecidableEq V] in
theorem empty_mem_boundedLists (k : ℕ) : (∅ : Finset V) ∈ boundedLists k := by
  simp [boundedLists]

/-- **Posterior vulnerability for guessing within `k` tries**, unnormalized. -/
noncomputable def kTryVulnerability (μ : X → Weight) (q : X → Q) (P : X → V) (k : ℕ) : Weight :=
  ∑ o, (boundedLists (V := V) k).sup' ⟨∅, empty_mem_boundedLists k⟩ (keptMass μ q P o)

/-- **The repair frontier is the total weight minus the `k`-try vulnerability.** -/
theorem repairFrontier_eq_sub_kTryVulnerability (μ : X → Weight) (q : X → Q) (P : X → V) (k : ℕ) :
    repairFrontier μ q P k = ∑ x, μ x - kTryVulnerability μ q P k := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · choose W hW hWeq using fun o =>
      Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup' ⟨∅, empty_mem_boundedLists (V := V) k⟩ (keptMass μ q P o)
    have hWmem : W ∈ boundedMenus (Q := Q) (V := V) k := by
      rw [boundedMenus, Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, fun o => (Finset.mem_filter.1 (hW o)).2⟩
    calc repairFrontier μ q P k ≤ menuRefusedMass μ q P W := by
          unfold repairFrontier
          exact Finset.inf'_le _ hWmem
      _ = ∑ x, μ x - ∑ o, keptMass μ q P o (W o) :=
          menuRefusedMass_eq_sub_sum_keptMass μ q P W
      _ = ∑ x, μ x - kTryVulnerability μ q P k := by
          rw [kTryVulnerability]
          congr 1
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun o _ => (hWeq o).symm
  · obtain ⟨T, hT, hTeq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_inf'
      ⟨_, empty_menu_mem_boundedMenus (Q := Q) (V := V) k⟩ (menuRefusedMass μ q P)
    have hTcard : ∀ o, (T o).card ≤ k := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hT).2
    unfold repairFrontier
    rw [hTeq, menuRefusedMass_eq_sub_sum_keptMass]
    apply sub_le_sub_left
    unfold kTryVulnerability
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro o _
    exact Finset.le_sup' (keptMass μ q P o)
      (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hTcard o⟩)

theorem repairFrontier_eq_one_sub_kTryVulnerability [One Weight] (μ : X → Weight) (h1 : ∑ x, μ x = 1)
    (q : X → Q) (P : X → V) (k : ℕ) :
    repairFrontier μ q P k = 1 - kTryVulnerability μ q P k := by
  rw [repairFrontier_eq_sub_kTryVulnerability, h1]

theorem kTryVulnerability_one [DecidableEq X] (EV : Enumeration V) (prior : X → ℚ)
    (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ prior x) (h1 : ∑ x, prior x = 1) (q : X → Q) (P : X → V) :
    kTryVulnerability prior q P 1 = 1 - bayesRisk EV (deterministicModel prior h0 h1 q) P := by
  have h := repairFrontier_eq_one_sub_kTryVulnerability prior h1 q P 1
  rw [repairFrontier_one_eq_bayesRisk EV prior h0 h1 q P] at h
  linarith

theorem kTryVulnerability_concave (μ : X → Weight) (q : X → Q) (P : X → V) (k : ℕ) :
    kTryVulnerability μ q P k + kTryVulnerability μ q P (k + 2) ≤
      kTryVulnerability μ q P (k + 1) + kTryVulnerability μ q P (k + 1) := by
  have h := repairFrontier_convex μ q P k
  rw [repairFrontier_eq_sub_kTryVulnerability μ q P k,
    repairFrontier_eq_sub_kTryVulnerability μ q P (k + 1),
    repairFrontier_eq_sub_kTryVulnerability μ q P (k + 2)] at h
  simpa only [sub_add_sub_comm, sub_le_sub_iff_left] using h

/-- The lists of exactly `k` values. -/
def exactLists (k : ℕ) : Finset (Finset V) := Finset.univ.filter fun W => W.card = k

omit [DecidableEq V] in
theorem exactLists_nonempty {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card V) : (exactLists (V := V) k).Nonempty := by
  obtain ⟨u, -, hcard⟩ := Finset.exists_superset_card_eq (s := (∅ : Finset V))
    (by simp) (by simpa using hk)
  exact ⟨u, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hcard⟩⟩

/-- **Exact-size form** of Alvim, Chatzikokolakis, Palamidessi, and Smith. -/
theorem kTryVulnerability_eq_exact (μ : X → Weight) (hμ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) (q : X → Q) (P : X → V)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card V) :
    kTryVulnerability μ q P k =
      ∑ o, (exactLists (V := V) k).sup' (exactLists_nonempty hk) (keptMass μ q P o) := by
  unfold kTryVulnerability
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro o _
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Finset.sup'_le
    intro W hW
    have hWk : W.card ≤ k := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hW).2
    obtain ⟨W', hWW', hW'card⟩ := Finset.exists_superset_card_eq (s := W) hWk (by simpa using hk)
    have hW'mem : W' ∈ exactLists (V := V) k :=
      Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hW'card⟩
    exact (keptMass_mono μ hμ q P o hWW').trans (Finset.le_sup' (keptMass μ q P o) hW'mem)
  · apply Finset.sup'_le
    intro W hW
    have hWk : W.card ≤ k := by
      rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hW).2]
    exact Finset.le_sup' (keptMass μ q P o)
      (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hWk⟩)

/-- Two states, one observation, identity target, uniform law: guessing within one try keeps one
half, within two tries all of it. -/
theorem twoVoids_kTryVulnerability :
    kTryVulnerability (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 / 2 : ℚ)) (fun _ => ()) (fun x : Fin 2 => x) 1 = 1 / 2 ∧
      kTryVulnerability (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 / 2 : ℚ)) (fun _ => ()) (fun x : Fin 2 => x) 2 = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, h1, h2⟩ := twoVoids_lift_or_refuse
  constructor
  · have h := repairFrontier_eq_one_sub_kTryVulnerability (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 / 2 : ℚ))
      (by norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_two]) (fun _ => ()) (fun x : Fin 2 => x) 1
    rw [h1] at h
    linarith
  · have h := repairFrontier_eq_one_sub_kTryVulnerability (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 / 2 : ℚ))
      (by norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_two]) (fun _ => ()) (fun x : Fin 2 => x) 2
    rw [h2] at h
    linarith

end Frontier

end OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.KTryVulnerability
